notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), and no hardware was attached or run.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0], deploy_robot/assets/mjcf/g1.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [...]}}: the control vector is checked against the model's actuator_ctrlrange before data.ctrl is written, then mj_step runs ticks times. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward. The state is the bridge's integration state (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed). The model has one free joint on the pelvis (g1.xml:136), 29 hinge joints and 29 motor actuators named after those joints (g1.xml:386-416), so the state has 36 qpos and 35 qvel values. No motor declares a ctrlrange, so the bridge publishes action.ctrl operator_required: a step that sets it is refused with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the deployment's site-limits.json bounds it. site-limits.example.json is an illustrative operator overlay (source operator, reason starts 'example only:'), not a model bound. The model declares no <option timestep>, so the bridge uses the engine default; the deployed upstream simulator overwrites it with G1MujocoConfig.dt = 0.002 s (mujoco_simulator.py:82, config/g1.py:10) and the fake uses 0.002 s as the same placeholder, which is why the published timestep_ms is 2.

WHY THIS SHAPE: the card's family-config decision and MujocoDriver helper express the MJCF scene the upstream simulation loads (deploy_robot/sim/config/g1.py:4-5, sim/mujoco_simulator.py:81-83). MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), and package code never imports the clone, so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py), named .fake:FakeMujoco in the lock; it parses the same model for the joint dimensions, the actuator count and targets, the absent ctrlrange and the option timestep, but integrates a placeholder velocity proportional to each control value. A backend name not listed (sim) would import the real mujoco module and load the same file; that path was not run. The clone was not modified or imported.

NOT COVERED: the upstream control layer. MujocoSimulator.step computes a PD torque from q, dq, trq, kp and kd joint commands and runs cfg.decimation (10) physics steps per control step (mujoco_simulator.py:275-283, :321-322, :339-346); the MuJoCo bridge writes data.ctrl directly and mj_step runs once per requested tick, so the PD law, the decimation and the controller-order joint remapping (G1JointNames) are not reproduced. The upstream MujocoEnv fixed-Hz thread and the DDS lowcmd/lowstate topic layer (mujoco_env.py:15-24, :36-43) and the viewer, rendering and sensors are not served. MuJoCo itself was never imported, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine or with the upstream simulator. No physical G1 is modelled or driven.

WARNINGS (all expected, none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND, because the fake backend is the package's stand-in for the mujoco module rather than a package class the gate can wrap in a Recorder; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, the integer/numeric inputs the simulator family derives. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds eight cases (model shape from the card model, a step that moves an actuated joint and advances time, a wrong control count, the LIMITS_UNSET refusal without an overlay, the example overlay's envelope refusal, reset, the published fidelity contract, and the e-stop latch); the gate's G9 repository tests passed. No catalogue_requests: the package uses only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 (cap.world.seed.v1 is not exposed by this bridge).

PUBLICATION: the upstream license is NOASSERTION (not stated), so the card's publish_review is required and this package must not be published before the owner's decision. The package declares no hardware backend and was never run against hardware or MuJoCo.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed the selected G1 MJCF, upstream simulator and excluded real constructor, derived operator-required control envelope, fake, stop/reset path and provenance. Corrected fake.py to restore the MJCF pelvis height and valid free-joint pose; driver.py now reports analytic:g1/F0 with snapshot_restore false on fake, narrows the source claims and discloses the broken upstream real constructor and retained controls. Updated test_driver.py, synchronized facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate, package tests and strict collector pass with contract_checked evidence only. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: The card remains NOASSERTION with publish_review required: an owner must resolve publication permission before publishing. The raw-model bridge omits the upstream PD controller, DDS wrapper and configured robot reset pose; no MuJoCo or hardware execution was performed. The excluded G1 real constructor calls ChannelFactoryInitialize before its function-local import and never assigns self.factory on that branch (deploy_robot/g1/g1.py:58-69). Control writes still require an operator overlay; e-stop retains state and controls until an explicit new step.
